title: Lyon · Vercors Balcony Roads
slogan: A 273 km loop out of Voiron
story: Cliffs, tunnels, balconies and the kind of roads riders remember. 273 km round from Voiron - plan on about 5 h 15 of riding. The stops in between: Pont-en-Royans village stop and Vassieux plateau meal. The climb of the day is Combe Laval balcony road. It tops out at about 900 m. The passes are the reason to go.

title: Pilat Ridge and Monastery Roads
slogan: A 135 km loop out of Yzeron ridge roads
